answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. A ocean of per-task receipts records who did what, and the horizon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. By the mirror of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
